description: ANDE provides electricity-development master plans covering generation, transmission, distribution, information systems and loss reduction. The official index identifies separate planning horizons and document links. The provider is Administración Nacional de Electricidad. Coverage: Coverage is Paraguay. Listed horizons are generation 2024–2043, transmission and distribution 2024–2033, ICT 2024–2035 and loss reduction 2025–2028. Access: The provider index was recovered with the web reader. Linked plan documents were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Plan horizons identify intended development, not completed assets. Assumptions and later amendments need checking before quantitative use. For simulation the documents supply official infrastructure and demand-planning assumptions. Related resources: This planning collection is distinct from ANDE’s undated current-generation page.
